description.value: 33 Brewing Experiment (33B) is the experimental taproom arm of 33 Acres Brewing Company, occupying a single-storey retail space on West 8th Avenue in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood. It operates on a walk-in basis with bar service alongside a seasonally rotating food menu, and can host private events for up to 60 guests. The location sits steps from the main 33 Acres taproom (33A) at 15 West 8th Avenue.
